Rudeness in all its glory.
I visited this dental clinic for the second time, as I needed a dental surgeon for a possible molar extraction and wanted a second opinion. I should mention that I am a foreigner and have been living in Thailand for 12 years. I haven’t encountered such behavior, not even in a low-grade bar. The doctor performed a test to check if my tooth hurt, but since I didn’t react, she immediately concluded that there was no pain. Additionally, she had an X-ray of the tooth, where the damage is clearly visible. After this “assessment,” when I mentioned that I’d been taking the antibiotic "GOFEN" for the past two days, for some reason she was offended, raised her voice, and demanded more RESPECT!!! I tried to understand what bothered her about my behavior. I only wanted to explain why my tooth wasn’t hurting at that moment—wasn’t it important to inform her? Instead, she considered it disrespectful and DEMANDED more respect. I tried to calmly end the misunderstanding, but she kept raising her voice and demanding more respect. I immediately got up and left, as there was no way I could work with her. So far, no one from the clinic has even apologized. I chose this clinic because it’s close to my home and has very good reviews. I respect every doctor who has worked hard to earn their degree and enter the workforce, but I am disappointed for her, as she doesn’t seem to understand that the relationship with the patient must be built for respect and trust to exist. Shame on you for your rude behavior. In another instance, I would have filed a complaint for the unprofessional conduct that you are obligated to avoid. Shame on you. I would like to note that the receptionist was very polite and that this was an isolated incident involving only one doctor. I am not blaming any other doctor. Respect and trust are earned, not demanded. For the good of all patients.

The best things about going here:

- They are honest - the dentist told me a certain treatment was unnecessary and …

Honest review:

The Good:

They are super professional, everything from start to finish the service was fantastic. I cannot fault it at all, and the technology they have with scanning your teeth and getting a full 3D colour image of everything is really great. They bring everything up on screen and can zoom in, showing you everything and talking through recommendations together. I've never experienced that at any other dentist in my life (in UK, Europe, Mexico, Colombia)

The bad:

I only really went in for a cleaning/scaling/polishing - however you want to call it, which typically would cost around 800-1200 THB in most other places I've been in my life. They told me the staining was only possible to be removed with their Airflow system - which I don't think is quite right because other dentists I've been to have always managed to do it and none have had Airflow. The cost then went from what they had quoted me previously as 1400-2000 THB, to 2,568 THB. I accepted even though it was more than I was expecting. Then at the end, they added another 250 THB on, for the 'consulation fee', which I don't think is really fair as they never mentioned that one.

So in summary, the service is really good, and they do a great job, but they really lay it on thick with the cost. It's more than triple what I paid the last dentist I went to (in Greece) for a scale & polish. The end result is more or less the same.
